title: EMBER global raw detection preview
mirror: Portolan Mirrors / Source Cooperative (independent, not NASA)
method: For each named year and month, sum exact count_YYYYMMDD columns from that year's aggregate-r5.parquet, rank nonzero A5 cells, and retain the 1,200 highest-count cells for display.
warning: Raw mixed-sensor detection counts are not harmonized and cannot be compared as a single long-term physical fire trend.

periods.quality: mixed SP/NRT only if present in source aggregate; not separable by month
periods.sensorScope: mixed fleet; aggregate has no month-by-sensor cross-tab
